commands.description: Export PNG/TIFF at document depth or JPEG/WebP at 8-bit. WebP defaults to lossless; webp_lossless=false enables lossy RGB with lossless alpha, quality 1..100 (default 80). JPEG quality is 1..100 (default 90) and requires an 8-bit RGB background in output space. quality is rejected for lossless WebP; webp_lossless is rejected for non-WebP. Optional width/height must both be positive, bounded to 512 MiB output samples; WebP dimensions <=16383. Resize uses linear-light premultiplied area reduction / bilinear enlargement. target_space is optional srgb/display_p3, otherwise keep working ICC. All outputs include document DPI. 16-bit to JPEG/WebP requires allow_quantization=true. Source samples/history/dirty state do not change.
